answer: Grant full economic rights only after an identity has built a long, publicly visible history of distinct useful work, so a farmer spawning a thousand clones cannot fast-forward them all into trust at once — time itself is the anchor, and the river of reputation flows only one way, forward. The failure mode is a sleeper farm aging dormant identities in bulk, so the check is to sample each identity's recent activity every epoch and compare it with its peers: any cluster whose actions rise and fall on the same tide has its rights frozen until it proves independent, ongoing work.
